properties.evidence: The lint fired on crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/engine/mod.rs:605 — a file that was in another repository until this decision, and is now reflow2's to lint. The decision also requires the absorbed files to stay byte-diffable against v0.12.0, so the finding had to be ALLOWED rather than fixed. Mechanism, not correlation: absorbing 7,913 lines under a verbatim-preservation requirement converts every future compiler lint over that code from a cleanup into a provenance decision. That standing cost was not named when the absorption was scoped.
